learning_objective: 🎯 Let us explore the quiet, peaceful, and magical beauty of the night time!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: When the bright sun sets, the sky turns dark and cool. It means it is time for the peaceful night to begin.
The beautiful silver moon and millions of tiny twinkling stars come out to play in the deep dark sky.
The little birds go back to their nests, and the animals go to sleep. Night time is a quiet time for us to rest our bodies.

fun_activity.title: 🌙 Moon Watcher
fun_activity.instructions: Look out of your window tonight. Draw the shape of the moon you see. Is it a full round circle or a little smile?

quick_recap: ⭐ Night time comes when the bright warm sun goes to sleep.
⭐ The moon and stars light up the dark night sky.
⭐ Night is a peaceful and quiet time for everyone to rest.
